links.outcome: LLM diagnostic classification F1 versus board-certified cardiologist on same CMR reports
links.effect: Top four LLMs outperformed the cardiologist (F1 0.94) across all metrics; Gemma 2 achieved F1 0.98, Qwen2.5:32B 0.96, DeepseekR1-32B 0.95.
links.quote: The top four LLMs outperformed our board-certified cardiologist (F1 scoreof 0.94) across all evaluation metrics in analyzing CMR reports.

unlisted_practices: Using locally deployed open-source LLMs for privacy-preserving extraction of diagnostic information from imaging reports

screen.reason: Evaluates the benchmark accuracy of locally-deployed open-source LLMs compared to a cardiologist on extracting diagnostic information from CMR reports, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard intervention.
